peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: AMD 35.8% with 3/3 replicate support; NVDA 24.0% with 3/3 replicate support; XYZ100 19.1% with 3/3 replicate support; MU 10.8% with 2/3 replicate support; SMSN 10.4% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Advanced Micro Devices
peers.reason: Most direct public substitute: x86 client and server CPUs plus data-center AI accelerators compete head-to-head with Intel's core franchises, so CPU share, product-cycle, and manufacturing-execution news should transmit fastest.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVIDIA is the dominant AI accelerator and data-center compute exposure; it competes for the same accelerator budget that Intel's AI roadmap addresses and it sets the semiconductor capex and risk regime that re-rates Intel.

peers.name: Nasdaq-100
peers.reason: Nasdaq-100 is the eligible dominant index comparator because it captures the US mega-cap technology and semiconductor systematic factor that explains a major share of Intel's return; this is economic exposure to the same data-center and PC demand complex, not merely high-beta co-movement.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: US semiconductor cycle comparator with the same PC and server demand, wafer, equipment, and advanced-packaging cost shocks; useful for Intel's cyclical semiconductor beta rather than as a product substitute.

peers.name: Samsung Electronics common
peers.reason: Samsung Electronics common shares are Intel's closest global business-model analog: an integrated device manufacturer combining memory with a foundry arm that competes directly with Intel Foundry for advanced-node customers, plus overlapping PC and server component exposure. The common line's 24-hour perp liquidity of 23.185 USD millions makes it executable as a peer leg.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: Nasdaq-100, an equity_index, is the cleanest hedge for Intel's generic systematic risk: Intel is a Nasdaq-100 constituent and a large share of its non-idiosyncratic moves is broad US mega-cap tech beta. It offers deep 24-hour perp liquidity of 112.11 USD millions versus Intel's 19.914 USD millions, and it is preferred over SOXL, which is a 3x leveraged wrapper, and over SP500, which dilutes the tech concentration that actually drives Intel's systematic returns.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

earningsOptions.source: consolidated listed-options chain, verified earnings calendars, and split-adjusted price history

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with verified calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
